Une caravane nationale et un dispositif: A national convoy and an emergency aid mechanism
L'opération de solidarité a été officiel: The solidarity operation was officially launched at the International Scout Centre in Algiers. The kickoff was given by the General Commander of the Algerian Muslim Scouts, Mr. Abderrahmane Hamzaoui, and the Director General of Ooredoo, Mr. Roni Tohme. This renewed partnership aims to support students from disadvantaged families across several wilayas of the country for the start of the school year.
L'action se déploie sur deux axes complé: The action is deployed along two complementary axes. The first consists of a national convoy delivering school bags and supplies. The second axis translates into a specific aid convoy intended for children in the wilayas of Jijel, Béjaïa, and Tizi Ouzou, regions heavily impacted by recent forest fires.
En marge de cette cérémonie de lancement: On the sidelines of this launch ceremony, the organizers rewarded the ten best students of the 2026 session who are members of the SMA. The top five winners of the middle school brevet exam (BEM) as well as the top five of the baccalaureate received distinctions for their academic results.
